items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Flip Phillips -- he's -- white musicians used to come uptown then. ... And then Flip started coming by, Flip -- Jazz at the Philharmonic --

ctx.x: Flip Phillips -- he's -- white musicians used to come uptown then. You know, it wasn't perilous for them. And we had a session going at all times, all hours, you know. That was our life. We had nothing else to do. We didn't have employment. That's for sure.
